note: The contract per returning-user state. Copy slots are IDs; the push, WhatsApp and email text here is placeholder copy written to show the shape (gap G08); the real copy lives in the CRM templates. scripts/gen_states.py draws N01 to N30 and H01a to H01k from this file.
rules: One nudge per week maximum across layers (spec v0.1, kept) applies from day 14 after payment. Before day 14 the onboarding states may nudge at 24 hours, 72 hours and day 7 (spec v0.1 S3, S4 cadence, kept). Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.
Every nudge deep-links to the primary action and names the specific next screen and its minutes; never continue your journey. Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.
O03's chosen time replaces the first scheduled nudge when it exists. Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.

Human escalation is an outbound call from the call centre; the CRM creates a task carrying the state ID, the missing fields and the tier. It does not consume the user's included calls. During the call the adviser enters inputs and the engine re-runs; nobody edits outputs by hand (spec v0.1, kept). brief V2.

Escalation by tier: DIWM gets the outbound call at day 7 of a data stall and on a second no-show; DIY gets the a la carte offer (K04) at the same points; DIFM is handled by the adviser relationship, not the ladder. Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.
Nudge copy slots are IDs (N-S4-72h); copy is content (gap G08) and lives in the CRM templates. The message text in this file is placeholder copy. Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.
State is computed on every open from stored flags; deep links land on the primary action (spec v0.1, kept).
States run S1 to S25. The next number is not used, and there is no state for anyone but the user. Vatsal, 10 Sep 2026.
